name: Week weather
summary: A 'rate your week' story where each friend sets a weather from sun to storm; the story shows one strip of sky per friend and the group's forecast, and tapping someone's rain or storm sends them an umbrella that stands for a coffee on you.
useWhen: rate your week story for finals
how's everyone doing this week, but fun
put a weather check in on my story for the six
monday check in thing where people can cheer each other up
calvin's having a rough week, let people send him something
dontUseWhen: a serious mental health check in (send a direct message)
picking a plan or a time (use story-poll-plan or meeting-time)
a vote on something with a winner (use after-vote)

ago.description: How long ago it went up, e.g. '3h'

question.description: The prompt on the story, e.g. 'rate your week'

gift.description: What an umbrella stands for, e.g. 'a Kettle & Crumb coffee'

ratings.description: Weather already set by friends in the chat: 0 sunny, 1 sun and clouds, 2 cloudy, 3 rain, 4 storm, with a line in their words

umbrellas.description: Umbrellas already sent; only to friends on rain or storm
